_comment: Regression fixture: display_name carries the very delimiters the bash side re-splits on (\u001f field, \u001e record) plus a newline and a DEL. Before the control-strip in load_scoped_weekly, bash forged TWO windows here with an attacker-chosen '100%' (which also fired the pegged easter egg) while PowerShell rendered one correct window - content injection and a byte-parity break in the same bug. Both must now render exactly one window at 21%.
